note: Upgrade Roadmap 2. References and explicit game assumptions are recorded in each row. Existing rows are unchanged.

systems.name: Water-Bath Canner
systems.description: Preserves acidified produce using a standing preservation rule.
systems.notes: Only the acidified fruit/vegetable portion of the blended produce resource is eligible; acidity and additives are abstracted. Never meat or root crops. https://nchfp.uga.edu/how/general-canning-information/ensuring-safe-canned-foods/ Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Electric Dehydrator
systems.description: Dries surplus produce or meat using electricity and spare labor.
systems.notes: 600 W reference unit; assumed 8-hour full batch uses 4.8 kWh. https://excaliburdehydratorsaustralia.com/pages/model-comparison Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Smokehouse
systems.description: Turns meat or fish into preserved food using wood and spare labor.
systems.notes: Preserved-food abstraction includes curing and drying; smoke alone is not represented as a safety guarantee. Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Cheese Press
systems.description: Turns milk into a smaller, slower-spoiling cheese supply.
systems.notes: 1.25 gal milk per pound cheese, NMSU Extension: https://pubs.nmsu.edu/_e/E216/index.html ; 1,800 kcal/lb cheese, 1% weekly spoilage are game assumptions; whey calories leave the food pool. Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Grain Bin
systems.description: Sealed grain capacity prevents the added rodent loss on protected grain.
systems.notes: LL-30: uncovered grain loses an additional 1%/week; 450 lb protected per bin (10 cu ft at existing catalog 45 lb/cu ft). Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Seed Saving Station
systems.description: Reserves garden produce for cleaning and drying seed instead of eating it.
systems.notes: One pound of seed-bearing garden output yields one ounce of Seeds per week; mixed-crop abstraction. LL-30 required. Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.
